مَسَاغٌ [A place of easy entrance or passage for beverage, or food, into the fauces or throat. ―
-b2- And hence,] (assumed tropical:) A place of entrance into a land [&c.]; as in a saying cited in the first paragraph of this art., q. v. (TA.) ―
-b3- And [hence] one says, هٰذَا لَا أَجِدُ لَهُ مَسَاغًا (tropical:) This, I do not find to it a passage, or an [easy] entrance; or a way, or place, of entrance. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
